\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python title=\"production_approval.py\"", "from pydantic_ai import Agent, ConversationTypeAdapter, DeferredToolRequests", "", "agent = Agent('anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5', output_type=[str, DeferredToolRequests])", "", "", "@agent.tool_plain(requires_approval=True)", "def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float) -> str:", "    return f'Refunded {amount} on order {order_id}'", "", "", "async def start(prompt: str) -> bytes:", "    result = await agent.run(prompt)", "    if isinstance(result.output, DeferredToolRequests):", "        ...  # ask a person about each call in result.output.approvals", "    return ConversationTypeAdapter.dump_json(result.conversation)  # store under result.conversation_id", "", "", "async def resume(", "    stored: bytes, approvals: dict[str, bool]", ") -> tuple[bytes, str | DeferredToolRequests]:", "    conversation = ConversationTypeAdapter.validate_json(stored)", "    assert conversation.deferred_tool_requests is not None", "    result = await agent.run(", "        conversation=conversation,", "        deferred_tool_results=conversation.deferred_tool_requests.build_results(approvals=approvals),", "    )", "    return ConversationTypeAdapter.dump_json(result.conversation), result.output  # store it again", "```"]
